coverLetterContent:
To the recruitment team,

Cara Core Informática presents this institutional Avatar profile for software engineering and modernization opportunities. The profile highlights consolidated experience in robust technology projects, with strong command of the Java EE stack and modern frameworks such as Spring Boot, Hibernate, and JSF.

Over the last five years, there has been continuous work in high-level consultancies, focused on corporate systems, REST APIs, messaging with RabbitMQ, extensive use of Docker, Oracle databases, and continuous integration practices with Git and Maven. Relevant projects were delivered for organizations such as RD Saúde, Banco do Brasil, Bradesco Saúde, Volkswagen, and Funasa, with quality and alignment to corporate standards.

Beyond technical practice, the profile demonstrates autonomous, proactive, and communicative delivery in agile and distributed environments. The engineering background, combined with Java specialization, enables a systemic understanding of business challenges and the design of high-value solutions.

Our team is available to discuss how this profile can contribute to your organization.

Sincerely,
Cara Core Avatar Team
Cara Core Informática.

skills.Java SE/EE: A robust platform for developing enterprise applications, from desktops to complex web systems with servlets and EJBs.
skills.Spring Boot: A framework that accelerates the development of Java applications, simplifying configuration and focusing on microservices.
skills.JSF: (JavaServer Faces) A standard technology for building web user interfaces with reusable components in the Java EE ecosystem.
skills.EJB: (Enterprise JavaBeans) A component architecture for building distributed, transactional business objects in Java EE.
skills.RESTful APIs: An architectural pattern for creating flexible and scalable web APIs based on HTTP operations (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE).
skills.JPA: (Java Persistence API) A specification that facilitates mapping Java objects to relational database tables (ORM).
skills.Hibernate: A popular implementation of the JPA specification, offering a powerful and flexible ORM framework.
skills.RabbitMQ: A message broker system that enables asynchronous and decoupled communication between different parts of a system.
skills.GraphQL: A query language for APIs that allows clients to request exactly the data they need, optimizing communication.
skills.OpenAPI: A specification for describing, documenting, and visualizing REST APIs, facilitating integration and consumption by other applications.
skills.Oracle: A robust relational database management system (RDBMS) widely used in corporate environments.
skills.PostgreSQL: An open-source object-relational RDBMS known for its reliability, robustness, and SQL standards compliance.
skills.SQL Server: Microsoft's relational RDBMS, with strong integration with other tools in the .NET and Windows platform.
skills.MySQL: A very popular open-source relational RDBMS for web applications, known for its speed and ease of use.
skills.MongoDB: A document-oriented NoSQL database, ideal for applications requiring schema flexibility and horizontal scalability.
skills.Firebird: An open-source relational RDBMS, lightweight and with low maintenance costs, suitable for embedded and small-scale systems.
skills.Docker: A platform for creating, deploying, and running applications in containers, ensuring consistency between development and production environments.
skills.Git: A distributed version control system, essential for tracking source code changes and team collaboration.
skills.CI/CD: (Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery) DevOps practices for automating the building, testing, and deployment of software.
skills.Microservices: An architectural approach to building an application as a collection of small, independent, and communicable services.
skills.Agile/Scrum: Project management methodologies that promote iterative development, collaboration, and rapid response to change.
skills.Python Automation with AI: Using Python scripts and AI libraries to automate tasks, manipulate data, and create intelligent solutions.
skills.Jakarta EE: It is the evolution of Java EE, an open-source platform for developing modern, cloud-native, and microservices-based Java applications.
